notes.title: Release date change
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439580/33260f9ad9f8e58f73b4a13117bca12a4a284239.png[/img]

We regret to announce that we must postpone the release date as we initially overestimated our development capacity. We sincerely apologize for this situation.

The game is currently in active development with core mechanics largely implemented. However, the current state of "Sadko" does not yet meet the quality standards we wish to deliver to our players. This difficult decision was made with that consideration in mind.

Thank you for staying with us during this process.
